requiredGates: A real KanaAI.TsfTip.dll exists and is a valid x64 PE DLL.
Windows registration, COM activation, language-profile, and application tests pass.
The TIP is verified in a 64-bit Windows application; registry entries alone are not proof.
readiness.completionRule: Registration is not complete until a real TIP DLL exists and Windows tests pass.

artifactContract.name: KanaAI.TsfTip.dll
artifactContract.note: The build harness deliberately refuses registration; this slice supplies a separately reviewed projection and never changes that build guard.

registrationApis.name: ITfInputProcessorProfiles.Register
registrationApis.purpose: Register the text-service CLSID with TSF.

registrationApis.name: ITfInputProcessorProfiles.AddLanguageProfile
registrationApis.purpose: Add the Japanese language profile and icon metadata.

registrationApis.name: ITfInputProcessorProfileMgr.RegisterProfile
registrationApis.purpose: Use the current TSF profile-manager registration entry point when building the registrar.

registrationApis.name: ITfCategoryMgr.RegisterCategory
registrationApis.purpose: Register the TIP categories supported by the compiled TIP.

registrationApis.name: InstallLayoutOrTip
registrationApis.purpose: Enable the profile for the current user; this is a per-user operation.

unregistrationApis.name: ITfInputProcessorProfiles.Unregister
unregistrationApis.purpose: Remove the text service and its profiles on uninstall.

unregistrationApis.name: ITfInputProcessorProfiles.RemoveLanguageProfile
unregistrationApis.purpose: Remove the language profile explicitly during uninstall.

unregistrationApis.name: ITfInputProcessorProfileMgr.UnregisterProfile
unregistrationApis.purpose: Use the current TSF profile-manager removal entry point when building the registrar.

unregistrationApis.name: InstallLayoutOrTip (disable; verify it is not the last language layout)
unregistrationApis.purpose: Disable the current user's layout only after checking Windows language-layout safety.

categories.guidSource: Windows SDK msctf.h constants; resolve at compile time rather than copying registry values

perUser.label: per-user developer registration
perUser.note: This is a development overlay and activation template. Production TSF provider registration and category registration must be supplied by a real TIP registrar and verified on Windows.

machine.label: machine-wide administrator registration
machine.note: The machine template is an explicit reviewable projection. ITfInputProcessorProfiles and ITfCategoryMgr calls, COM registration, activation, and Windows tests remain required.

x64.registryViewGuidance: Use a 64-bit PowerShell/reg.exe and RegistryView.Registry64. A 32-bit process must not write the x64 TIP view.

x86.blockedReason: The x86 TIP is not part of this slice. Do not register a 32-bit placeholder or claim x86 compatibility.
x86.registryViewGuidance: When an x86 TIP is later added, use a 32-bit installer/reg.exe and RegistryView.Registry32; do not point it at the x64 Program Files directory.
